EUR.EUR/USD: EUR/USD trades near 1.1612, consolidating below its 20-day moving average of 1.1629 while holding above the 50-day moving average at 1.1529 ahead of upcoming inflation data. European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde and the Governing Council deliver an expected rate stance as a 25-basis-point hike remains priced in by money markets to address sticky underlying inflation. On the US side, oil and rates surging ahead of US CPI today dominate immediate cross-asset price action, with the US 10-year yield pushing toward 4.944% and steepening the 2s10s curve. Institutional forecasters including Nomura note that policy divergence between the ECB and the Federal Reserve could structurally support the single currency into medium-term horizons
EUR.EUR/GBP: EUR/GBP trades in a tight range as market participants weigh relative European monetary policy dynamics against internal rifts within the Bank of England. The ECB maintains a hawkish posture with a rate hike priced in for upcoming policy cycles, offering underlying baseline support for the euro. In the UK, Bank of England External Member Megan Greene advocates for proactive policy tightening to mitigate energy shock spillovers, directly contrasting with Deputy Governor Dave Ramsden's preference for patience. GBP COT LF long +47.5k. BoE on hold
EUR.EUR/JPY: EUR/JPY exhibits downside consolidation around the 179.00 level, remaining technically capped below its 100-day simple moving average. The pair faces headwind pressures as Bank of Japan Policy Board Member Masu signaled that interest rates must normalize from sub-neutral levels, backing swap market pricing for a 25-basis-point BoJ rate hike next week. Despite an ECB hike priced in by money markets, Japanese yield adjustment expectations are driving selective profit-taking on long euro carry positions. JPY COT LF short -111.3k. BoJ hike expected
EUR.EUR/AUD: EUR/AUD remains under moderate pressure as Australian rate expectations maintain a firm floor under the Aussie dollar. The ECB has an interest rate hike priced in, providing steady fundamental support, but domestic Australian headline inflation running at 3.6% keeps money markets pricing over a 70% probability of a September RBA rate hike. Cross-currency flows reflect strong long-side positioning in antipodean high-beta FX relative to core European space. AUD COT LF long +50.2k. RBA on hold
EUR.EUR/CAD: EUR/CAD trades with a firm tone as energy market developments and differential monetary policy paths reprice cross-currency risk. The European Central Bank has an ECB rate hike priced in, reinforcing short-term deposit rate support. Meanwhile, elevated global crude prices above $100 per barrel offer underlying support to the Canadian dollar despite active cross-border trade and tariff headwind headlines. CAD COT LF short -70.1k. BoC hike expected
